notes: Confirmed permanently closed: Yelp lists it as 'JULIAN GRILLE - CLOSED', a bizbuysell.com business-for-sale listing describes 'the restaurant is currently closed, providing a new owner the opportunity to reopen or reposition the property', and a Facebook community post ('The Closure of The Julian Grille Restaurant') describes the landlord forcing it to close permanently and the business now for sale. name: H Brothers
notes: Read from the restaurant's own Menufy/HungerRush ordering platform (hbrotherstogo.com, locationId 28937); address in the payload matches exactly (212 East Grand Avenue, Escondido, CA 92025). Grubhub's listing for the same restaurant shows several of the same items ~20% higher (e.g. Western Grilled Chicken Sandwich $19.20 on Grubhub vs $15.99 here) -- that is Grubhub's delivery markup, not the wall price, so Grubhub was not used and not cross-checked against.

name: Barlando
notes: Read directly from the restaurant's own site (barlandobar.com/food-drink-menu/), which matches the batch address (6548 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92115) and phone. Site notes this location rebranded from 'Corbin's Q' to 'Barlando' (per whatnow.com and smithallengroup.com coverage), same address/operator, still active per Yelp ('Now Accepting Reservations') and Instagram. Weekly day-of-week bar promos (e.g. 'Margarita Monday $9', 'Pint Night Wednesday $5') were excluded as discounted specials rather than standing menu items; the Weekly Bar Deals section duplicated the Daily Bar Deals prices and was deduped. Tri-Tip is priced per pound ($34/lb) per the site; noted in description. Sides share one price ($5.50) across a pick-list, filed as a single row.

notes: Restaurant's own site (ilovebagelsoceanside.com) is a static template with no prices anywhere on the page (JS-driven menu tabs render no data in a plain fetch). Found the restaurant's own Toast ordering platform instead; the Toast page's internal restaurant name is literally 'I Love Bagels 3910 Vista Way', matching the batch address (3910 Vista Way Ste 101, Oceanside, CA 92056) exactly, confirming identity. Two other 'I Love Bagels' domains (ilovebagelsln.com, ilovebagelsinc.com) turned up in search but are unrelated same-name businesses at different addresses and were not used. 136 priced items extracted across 6 sections (Bagels, Bagel With, Breakfast Bagel, Deli Sandwiches, Desserts, Drinks, Sides).

name: The Grill at Torrey Pines
notes: Restaurant's own site (lodgetorreypines.com/the-grill) is marketing prose only, no prices. Used the SinglePlatform listing instead, which carries the exact batch address (11480 North Torrey Pines Road) and matches a corroborating price snippet independently seen on OpenTable ('Eggs any Style $23.00' identical on both). Menu spans six sections that repeat some dishes at different prices per meal period (e.g. Eggs Benedict $24 at Breakfast vs $34 at Weekend Brunch, Avocado Toast $20 at Lunch vs $28 at Weekend Brunch) -- these were kept as separate rows tagged by their own meal-period section rather than deduped, since the price genuinely differs by period. The Dessert section listed one flat price ($13) applying to all five listed desserts with no individual prices, so all five were filed at $13 each per the site's own pricing format. 'Add-on' lines (e.g. 'Add Fried Egg $5.00') are itemized on the source with their own prices and were kept as their own rows.
